upstream.title_as_documented: Cell Tracking with the new laprust

reused_protocol_elements.element: Eight CTC excerpts plus the Hydra example.
CTC sequence 02; final up to 100 imperfect segmentation masks as prepared detections.
reused_protocol_elements.difference: ICPE enumerates and hashes the selected masks, verifies frame continuity, and prepares detections with GroundTruthDetector over the mask video.

reused_protocol_elements.element: Hydra zero-based frames 130-229; mean-channel projection; normalization at 0.01/0.999 quantiles with smooth clipping at 1.0; CPU wavelet detector scale 1, k 2.5, min_area 5, batch_size 20.
identical_short_api_lines: detector = WaveletDetector(scale=1, k=2.5, min_area=5, batch_size=20, device=torch.device("cpu"))
reused_protocol_elements.difference: ICPE takes an already-local video path and records its SHA-256 instead of obtaining the example through the upstream example-data helper.

reused_protocol_elements.element: Use ByoTrack KalmanLinker, estimate motion parameters from prepared detections, select Pylapy backends, and time complete linker runs after warmup.

study_protocol_changes: Three dense OPT_ALT arms: stock padded SciPy, capped rectangular SciPy, and LAPX Rust; original protocol also included sparse LAPMOD and SciPy csgraph arms.
Motion parameters are estimated once and shared across arms; context-managed backend selection restores Pylapy settings.
One whole-clip warmup per arm followed by six balanced arm orders shuffled with seed 20261113, replacing three consecutive measurements per backend.
Logical CPU 0, one-thread numerical libraries, garbage-collection control, and nanosecond timing.
Track digests include identity, lifespan-related metadata, coordinates/missing masks, and detection indices, and compare all timed and instrumented runs.
Input and cost hashes, recorded objective comparisons, and separate instrumented association profiles supplement the original cross-backend position check.
Reported table times are six-round medians from the ICPE saved campaign, not the original benchmark mean/min summaries.
